transport: No transport. Two-conductor analogue thermistor on a 15 ft lead, adhesive-mounted to a battery case, plugged into the host controller's 6-pin jack labelled "Batt Temp". No bus, no address, no framing, no protocol — nothing to talk to. The reading is only obtainable through the host charge controller. On a MidNite Classic that host path is Modbus TCP (port register 4137, vendor default 502) or Modb
blocks: Host-side only — these are MidNite Classic registers, not the sensor's. 4132 BATTtemperature = ([4132]/10) degC, "Temperature measured at the external Battery Temperature Sensor (if installed, else 25C)". 4130/4131 InfoFlagsBits, read as one 32-bit value ([4131]<<16)+[4130]: bit 0x00002000 "Battery Temp Sensor Installed", bit 0x08000000 "TempCompShortedF". 4327 BatteryTempPassed = Follow-Me temp sensor value shared from a neighbouring Classic. Adjacent but NOT this sensor: 4133 FETtemperature, 4134 PCBTemperature. Charger-side temp-comp settings 4155 max comp voltage, 4156 min comp voltage, 4157 mV/degC per 2 V cell (manual: typically -5 mV). All addresses transcribed from the vendor register map PDF via pdftotext, not inferred.
refutedOnReview: REFUTED. Verified all three staged vendor PDFs directly.  1. MNBTS has no register map at all. It is a passive analog thermistor on a 6-pin RJ plug, not a Modbus device — no slave ID, no baud rate, no registers. A "dialect" asserting a shared register map is a category error, and a one-member "these models share one map" set is vacuous regardless.  2. The two cited documents that actually contain registers never name

unmappedReports: FETtemperature (Classic reg 4133) — power-FET die temperature. No MetricKind fits: `temperature` is documented as ambient, `battery-temperature` is explicitly at the bank. Same gap cabin-epever hit with 0x3111 (temperature inside the controller), so this is the second independent occurrence — worth a contract variant rather than two drivers each mislabelling it., PCBTemperature (Classic reg 4134) — controller top-PCB temperature. Same gap as above., "Battery Temp Sensor Installed" (InfoFlagsBits 0x00002000) — probe presence. No MetricKind, and no way to express "this metric's source hardware is absent" other than the driver reporting the metric unavailable., "TempCompShortedF" (InfoFlagsBits 0x08000000) — probe or wiring shorted. A fault about a sensor, not a value; no MetricKind and no fault channel for it., BatteryTempPassed (Classic reg 4327) — battery temperature received from another Classic over Follow-Me/BTSNET. Same MetricKind, different provenance; the contract has no way to mark a reading as relayed rather than measured, which matters because it is how one probe becomes three identical readings (see gotchas).
